title: KET 分级读物（全原创）
note: 起点蓝思 200-400L，逐步爬到 400-500L。必须「几乎不用查词」才有效。音乐题材加量（孩子是乐团成员）。

articles.title: My Cat Mimi
articles.content: I have a cat. Her name is Mimi. She is white and grey. Mimi sleeps a lot. She sleeps on my bed. She sleeps on the sofa. She even sleeps in my school bag! Every morning I give her fish and milk. She says "miaow" to me. That means "thank you". I love my cat very much.
articles.translation: 我有一只猫，名叫咪咪。她是白灰色的。咪咪很爱睡觉：睡在我床上、睡在沙发上，甚至睡进我的书包里！每天早上我给她鱼和牛奶。她对我「喵」一声，那是在说「谢谢」。我非常爱我的猫。

articles.title: Our Classroom
articles.content: Our classroom is big and bright. There are twenty desks and a green board. My desk is near the window. I can see the playground from my seat. We have a small garden by the door. We grow red flowers there. Our teacher, Miss Wu, puts our best work on the wall. My picture is there this week!
articles.translation: 我们的教室又大又亮。有二十张课桌和一块绿色的黑板。我的课桌靠窗，从座位能看到操场。门边有个小花园，我们在那里种红花。吴老师会把我们最好的作业贴到墙上。这星期贴的是我的画！

articles.title: Breakfast at Grandma's
articles.content: On Sunday I go to Grandma's house. She makes the best breakfast. There are eggs, hot milk and little cakes. Grandma says, "Eat more, you are growing!" Her kitchen smells sweet. After breakfast, we wash the dishes together. I wash and she dries. Then we sit in the sun and she tells me stories about Mum when she was small.
articles.translation: 星期天我去奶奶家。她做的早餐最好吃：有鸡蛋、热牛奶和小蛋糕。奶奶说：「多吃点，你在长身体！」她的厨房闻起来甜甜的。饭后我们一起洗碗，我洗她擦。然后我们坐在阳光里，她给我讲妈妈小时候的故事。

articles.title: The Red Bike
articles.content: Tom has a red bike. It is old but fast. Every day after school, he rides it around the park. One day, his friend Lin's bike broke. Lin was sad because he lives far from school. "Take my bike this week," Tom said. "But how will you go home?" asked Lin. "I will run! It is good sport," Tom laughed. Now they are best friends.
articles.translation: 汤姆有一辆红色自行车，旧但是快。每天放学后他都绕着公园骑。有一天，朋友林的车坏了。林很难过，因为他家离学校远。「这周骑我的车吧。」汤姆说。「那你怎么回家？」林问。「我跑步！正好锻炼。」汤姆笑了。现在他们是最好的朋友。

articles.title: Rain, Rain
articles.content: It rained all day on Saturday. I could not play outside. First I was bored. Then Mum gave me an idea. We put a big white sheet on the wall and made shadow animals with our hands! Dad's dog shadow was so funny. My bird shadow could fly. We laughed a lot. Now I hope it rains again next Saturday!
articles.translation: 星期六下了一整天雨，我不能出去玩。一开始我很无聊。后来妈妈想了个主意：我们在墙上挂一块大白布，用手做影子动物！爸爸的小狗影子特别好笑，我的小鸟影子还会飞。我们笑个不停。现在我倒希望下周六再下雨！

articles.title: My First Violin Lesson
articles.content: I remember my first violin lesson. The violin looked so small and shiny. My teacher showed me how to hold it under my chin. It felt strange, like holding a sleeping cat! My first sound was terrible — like a door crying. The teacher smiled and said, "Every great player starts with a crying door." Now, three years later, my violin sings. But I still remember that funny first sound.
articles.translation: 我记得第一节小提琴课。琴看起来又小又亮。老师教我把它夹在下巴下面，感觉怪怪的，像抱着一只睡着的猫！我拉出的第一个声音糟透了——像一扇门在哭。老师笑着说：「每个了不起的演奏家都是从哭泣的门开始的。」三年后的现在，我的琴会唱歌了。但我还记得那个好笑的第一声。

articles.title: The School Trip
articles.content: Last Friday our class went to the city museum. We saw old coins, a king's hat and a dinosaur as tall as our school! My friend Amy took many photos. The best part was the science room. We could touch everything there. I made a small light turn on with a wheel. On the bus home, everyone was tired and quiet. Miss Lee said it was the quietest we have ever been!
articles.translation: 上周五我们班去了城市博物馆。我们看到了古钱币、国王的帽子，还有一只和我们学校一样高的恐龙！我朋友艾米拍了好多照片。最棒的是科学室，那里什么都可以摸。我用一个轮子让小灯亮了起来。回程大巴上大家又累又安静。李老师说这是我们班有史以来最安静的一次！

articles.title: Noodles for Dinner
articles.content: My dad makes noodles every Friday night. He does not buy them from a shop — he makes them with his hands! First he mixes flour and water. Then he pulls the dough, longer and longer, until it becomes a hundred thin noodles. I always watch him. It looks like magic. "The secret," Dad says, "is to be patient." The noodles dance in the hot soup. Friday dinner is my favourite dinner of the week.
articles.translation: 我爸爸每周五晚上做面条。他不从店里买——他用手做！先和面，然后把面团拉得越来越长，直到变成上百根细面条。我总在旁边看，像看魔术一样。「秘诀是，」爸爸说，「要有耐心。」面条在热汤里跳舞。周五的晚饭是我一周里最爱的一顿。

articles.title: A Letter to My Cousin
articles.content:
Dear Fei,
How are you? I have big news — we are coming to your city this summer! Mum booked the train tickets yesterday. The trip takes five hours, so I will bring two books and my music player. Can we go to the beach near your home? I want to swim in the sea for the first time! Mum says your mum's fish soup is famous in our family. I can't wait to try it.
Your cousin, Hua
articles.translation: 亲爱的飞：你好吗？我有大消息——今年夏天我们要去你的城市了！妈妈昨天订好了火车票。路上要五个小时，所以我会带两本书和音乐播放器。我们能去你家附近的海滩吗？我想第一次在大海里游泳！妈妈说你妈妈做的鱼汤在我们家族里很有名，我等不及要尝了。你的表妹，华

articles.title: The Lost Ticket
articles.content: At the train station, Grandpa could not find his ticket. He looked in his coat. He looked in his bag. He even looked in his shoe! "Think, Grandpa," I said. "What did you do after you bought it?" He closed his eyes. "I bought the tickets... then I bought you an ice cream..." We both looked at my hand. There, under my ice cream, was a small blue ticket! Grandpa laughed so hard that people turned to look at us.
articles.translation: 在火车站，爷爷找不到他的票了。他翻了外套、翻了包，甚至看了鞋里！「想想看，爷爷，」我说，「你买完票之后做了什么？」他闭上眼睛：「我买了票……然后给你买了个冰淇淋……」我们俩同时看向我的手——就在我的冰淇淋下面，压着一张蓝色的小票！爷爷笑得太大声，路人都转过头来看我们。

articles.title: The Music Room Ghost
articles.content: Every Tuesday after school, someone played the piano in the empty music room. We heard it, but when we opened the door, nobody was there! "It's a ghost," said Ben. I did not believe him, so one day we waited quietly outside. The music started — soft and slow. I pushed the door fast. It was the school cat! She walked on the piano keys, looking for a warm place to sleep. Now we call her Miss Mozart, and she is the most famous cat in school.
articles.translation: 每周二放学后，空空的音乐教室里总有人弹钢琴。我们听得到，可推门进去却没有人！「是鬼。」本说。我不信，于是有一天我们在门外悄悄等。音乐响起来了——又轻又慢。我猛地推开门——是学校的猫！她踩在琴键上，找暖和的地方睡觉。现在我们叫她「莫扎特小姐」，她成了学校里最有名的猫。

articles.title: Sports Day
articles.content: I am not the fastest runner in my class. At sports day last year, I came last in the short race. This year, I chose the long race instead. My PE teacher taught me a secret: "Do not run fast at the start. Keep your legs happy for the end." Around the field we ran, once, twice, three times. One by one, the fast starters got tired. On the last corner, I passed four runners. I finished third! Sometimes slow at the start means strong at the end.
articles.translation: 我不是班里跑得最快的。去年运动会短跑我是最后一名。今年我改选了长跑。体育老师教我一个秘诀：「起跑别快，把腿力留到最后。」我们绕着操场跑，一圈、两圈、三圈。那些起跑很快的人一个个累了。最后一个弯道，我超过了四个人，拿到第三名！有时候，开始慢就是结尾强。

articles.title: The New Girl
articles.content: A new girl came to our class in March. Her name was Aliya and she came from another country. She knew only a few words of Chinese, and she ate lunch alone. One day I sat next to her and drew a cat on my notebook. She smiled and drew a bird. I drew a tree for the bird. She drew a sun above my tree. We did not talk much that day, but we made a whole picture together. Now Aliya is my best friend, and she talks more than anyone in class!
articles.translation: 三月，班里来了个新同学。她叫阿莉娅，来自另一个国家。她只会几个中文词，午饭总是一个人吃。有一天我坐到她旁边，在笔记本上画了一只猫。她笑了，画了一只鸟。我给鸟画了一棵树，她在树上画了个太阳。那天我们没说几句话，却一起完成了一整幅画。现在阿莉娅是我最好的朋友——而且她成了班里话最多的人！

articles.title: Grandpa's Radio
articles.content: Grandpa has an old radio, older than my mum. Its sound is not clear, and sometimes you must hit it softly to make it work. "Why don't you buy a new one?" I asked. Grandpa turned the radio on. An old song came out, soft and warm. "I listened to this song with your grandma fifty years ago," he said. "A new radio plays music. This one plays memories." I did not really understand then. But last night, I heard that song again, and I thought of Grandpa's smile.
articles.translation: 爷爷有台老收音机，比我妈妈年纪还大。声音不清楚，有时得轻轻拍一下才响。「为什么不买台新的？」我问。爷爷打开收音机，一首老歌流出来，又轻又暖。「五十年前，我和你奶奶一起听这首歌，」他说，「新收音机放的是音乐，这台放的是回忆。」当时我没太懂。但昨晚我又听到那首歌，想起了爷爷的笑容。

articles.title: The Broken String
articles.content: It happened in the middle of the school concert. I was playing my violin solo when — TWANG! — my A string broke. The hall went quiet. My face felt hot. I wanted to run off the stage. Then I saw my teacher in the first row. She pointed calmly at her own violin, then at me. I understood: keep playing, use the other strings. I moved my fingers to new places and finished the song. It was not perfect, but the clapping was the loudest I ever heard. "Music is not about perfect," my teacher said later. "It is about not stopping."
articles.translation: 事情发生在学校音乐会中途。我正拉小提琴独奏——「嘣」的一声，A 弦断了。全场安静下来，我的脸发烫，只想逃下台。这时我看见坐在第一排的老师。她平静地指指自己的琴，又指指我。我懂了：继续拉，用其他的弦。我把手指挪到新的位置，把曲子拉完了。虽不完美，但那是我听过最响的掌声。「音乐不在于完美，」老师后来说，「在于不停下来。」

articles.title: One Yuan
articles.content: On my way to school, I found one yuan on the ground. One yuan cannot buy much — half a bottle of water, maybe. I almost walked past it. Then I remembered the collection box at school. Our class was collecting money to buy books for a small village school. One yuan can be one page of a book, I thought. I picked it up and put it in the box. Weeks later, we got a photo from the village: thirty children holding new books, all smiling. Somewhere in those pages, there was my one yuan.
articles.translation: 上学路上，我在地上发现一枚一元硬币。一块钱买不了什么——大概半瓶水。我差点走了过去。然后我想起学校的捐款箱：我们班在为一所乡村小学捐书。一块钱也许就是书里的一页纸，我想。我捡起来投进了箱子。几周后，我们收到村小的照片：三十个孩子举着新书，全都在笑。那些书页里的某一页，是我的一块钱。

articles.title: The Weather Reporter
articles.content: For homework, our teacher asked us to watch the sky for one week and write a weather report. I thought it would be boring. I was wrong. On Monday, the clouds looked like sheep. On Tuesday, the wind pushed them into one long dragon. Wednesday brought rain, and I learned that rain smells — really! The air smells clean and green after it. On Friday, I saw two rainbows at the same time. My report was three pages long, the longest homework I ever wrote. Now I look up at the sky every day, even without homework.
articles.translation: 老师布置的作业是：观察天空一周，写一份天气报告。我以为会很无聊。我错了。周一，云像一群绵羊；周二，风把它们推成一条长龙；周三下了雨，我发现雨是有气味的——真的！雨后的空气闻起来又干净又清新。周五，我同时看到了两道彩虹。我的报告写了三页，是我写过最长的作业。现在就算没有作业，我每天也会抬头看看天。

articles.title: Dumplings at Midnight
articles.content: On the last night of the year, nobody in my family goes to bed early. The kitchen becomes the busiest place in the house. Grandma makes the dough, Mum mixes the meat and vegetables, and Dad tries to fold the dumplings — his always look like sleepy fish. My job is to hide one clean coin inside a lucky dumpling. At midnight, we eat them hot and watch each other carefully. Whoever finds the coin will have good luck all year. Last year Grandma found it. This year, I really, really hope it is me!
articles.translation: 每年的最后一个晚上，我们家没人早睡。厨房变成全家最忙的地方：奶奶和面，妈妈拌肉馅和菜，爸爸负责包——他包的饺子总像犯困的鱼。我的任务是把一枚干净的硬币藏进一只幸运饺子里。午夜时分，我们吃着热腾腾的饺子，小心地互相观察。谁吃到硬币，谁就全年好运。去年是奶奶吃到的。今年，我真的真的希望是我！

articles.title: The Quiet Drummer
articles.content: My little brother Kai never talks much, but his hands are never quiet. He drums on tables, on boxes, on the back of my chair when I do homework — tap-tap-ta-tap. It drove me crazy. Then, at the school talent show, a drummer got ill just before the show. The music teacher looked around and asked, "Can anyone play?" Kai, who never puts his hand up in class, walked to the drums without a word. What happened next made the whole school stand up. My quiet brother made the loudest, happiest sound I ever heard. Now, when he drums on my chair, I don't say anything. I just listen.
articles.translation: 我弟弟小凯不爱说话，但他的手从不安静。他敲桌子、敲盒子，我写作业时敲我的椅背——嗒嗒-嗒-嗒。烦死我了。后来学校才艺表演，一个鼓手临上场前病了。音乐老师环顾四周问：「有人会打鼓吗？」上课从不举手的小凯，一言不发走向了鼓。接下来发生的事让全校起立。我那个安静的弟弟，敲出了我听过最响亮、最快乐的声音。现在他再敲我的椅背，我什么都不说了。我只是听。

articles.title: A Map of My Town
articles.content: My town is too small for most maps. You cannot find it in the airport books, and tourists never come here. So last month, I decided to make my own map. I drew the noodle shop where the cook knows everyone's order. I drew the bridge where old men play chess and never finish their games. I drew our school, the river, and the tree that is perfect for reading under. My teacher put the map on the classroom wall. "This is the best kind of map," she said. "It shows not just where things are, but why they matter." One day, when I travel far away, this map will bring me home.
articles.translation: 我的家乡太小，大多数地图上都没有它。机场的书里找不到，游客也从不来。所以上个月，我决定自己画一张地图。我画了那家面馆——厨师记得每个人常点什么；画了那座桥——老人们在那儿下棋，棋局永远下不完；画了学校、小河，还有那棵最适合在下面看书的树。老师把地图贴在教室墙上。「这是最好的那种地图，」她说，「它不光标出东西在哪里，还标出它们为什么重要。」将来有一天，当我远行时，这张地图会带我回家。
